Moulded architrave switch with rounded edges. 2-way switching allows light to be operated from two locations, such as top and bottom of stairs or at either end of a hallway. Front plate resistant to fading, discolouration and scratches, with inherent anti-microbial properties to reduce bacterial development and inhibit the growth of infectious diseases. Narrow backplate ideal for fitting in tight corners, or where door frames are close together. Screw caps offer a sleek appearance.
